Figure 1: Conceptual illustration of the PET method: the red shaded area corresponds to D ⊂ [0, 1). The procedure consists of three steps: 1) estimating IPW estimators for the WATE (black dots), 2) modeling these estimates using a polynomial function (solid line), and 3) extrapolating to recover the ATE (dashed line). The star indicates the resulting proposed ATE estimator.
